articles.title: Fauci Caught in the Lie: Rand Paul Demands DOJ Probe Perjury on Gain-of-Function Funding
articles.summary: Sen. Rand Paul has formally requested a DOJ investigation into Anthony Fauci for allegedly lying under oath during a 2021 congressional hearing about whether the NIH funded gain-of-function research at the Wuhan Institute of Virology. If the allegation holds, Fauci perjured himself before Congress while shaping the entire public narrative on COVID-19 origins. The implications extend beyond one man — this is about whether the agency that funded the research also controlled the story about it.

articles.title: Fauci's Diary: Praised China, Trashed Trump, Lost Classified Files in Ransomware Hack — All Hidden From Public

articles.title: Oncology's Dirty Secret: Off-Patent Drugs Like Ivermectin May Fight Cancer — And That's Exactly Why You Won't Hear About Them

Ivermectin and other repurposed agents have demonstrated anti-tumor properties in peer-reviewed research, yet physicians face professional consequences for recommending them. The suppression isn't scientific — it's financial.

articles.title: Doctors and Researchers Worldwide Break Ranks: The Health System Is a Profit Machine, Not a Healing System

When a Supreme Court echoes the dissidents, the mainstream can no longer call it fringe.

articles.title: Medical Monopoly Exposed: How American Medicine Systematically Crushed Naturopathy to Protect Its Market

Practitioners have faced licensing battles, professional ridicule, and institutional exclusion — not because the science failed, but because the economics threatened the drug-based model. The Journal of Applied Natural Medicine is one of the few outlets willing to document what was buried.

articles.title: COVID Billing Fraud Was Industrial-Scale: Plano Clinics Pay $20 Million for Swabs Billed as Doctor Visits

This is not an isolated incident — it is a documented pattern of pandemic-era financial fraud committed against taxpayers under the cover of public health emergency declarations. The system that demanded compliance extracted billions while committing the fraud it prosecuted others for.

articles.title: Beta Bionics Hid Safety Data on FDA-Cleared iLet Device — Stock Collapsed 37% When Truth Emerged

A securities fraud class action has been filed after the stock crashed more than 37% when the concealed problems surfaced. This is the FDA clearance pipeline failing in real time: a device approved, deployed, and then revealed to have undisclosed safety issues.

articles.title: Repurposed Drug Mebendazole Suppresses Drug-Resistant Lung Cancer Tumors — So Why Is Oncology Still Ignoring It?

articles.title: Off-Patent Drug Ivermectin Showing Real Promise in Cancer — So Why Won't Oncology Acknowledge It?
